from pathlib import Path
p = Path('frontend/src/api/client.test.ts')
s = p.read_text()
old_queue = 'expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin/memories?limit=25&status=approved");'
new_queue = 'expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin/memories?limit=25&status=approved");'
old_redaction = 'expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[1][0]).toBe("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin/memories/memory-1/redaction");'
new_redaction = 'expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][0]).toBe("http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/admin/memories/memory-1/redaction");'
if s.count(old_queue) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'queue assertion count: {s.count(old_queue)}')
if s.count(old_redaction) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'redaction assertion count: {s.count(old_redaction)}')
s = s.replace(old_queue, new_queue, 1).replace(old_redaction, new_redaction, 1)
p.write_text(s)
